from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class SharesPeriod(BaseModel):
    """Weighted-average shares for one reporting period in a company's filing."""
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2025'")
    basic_shares: str | None = Field(description="Weighted-average basic shares as reported")
    diluted_shares: str | None = Field(description="Weighted-average diluted shares as reported")
    basic_shares_float: float | None = Field(description="Basic shares as a float for comparison")
    diluted_shares_float: float | None = Field(description="Diluted shares as a float for comparison")

class Company(BaseModel):
    """One company's 10-Q filing with all share data for the task."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of filing, e.g., 'Form 10-Q'")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="Report date or period end date")
    shares_periods: list[SharesPeriod] = Field(description="Weighted-average basic and diluted shares for each period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[Company]
